subject: CLAIM render-lead-opus (KCALL mem/map churn, top priority): nord2_metal_bridge.c cmdpool_get/put/reclaim + CMDPOOL_* + reap bookkeeping; metal/tegu/nord2_transport.inc KCALL (adds TEGU_PERF_KCALL_SITE); compute_frontend.m TeguBuffer newBufferWithLength/dealloc (buffer pool) + tegu_buffer_map_slow; tools/frame_bench_main.m FB_CALOOP counters. Root's uncommitted bisect defaults in compute_frontend.m/render_pipeline.inc untouched.
body: Device C6r window: mem 4953 / map 4798 per 1678 submits = ~2.9 mem + ~2.9 map per KERNEL JOB, i.e. per-job bridge churn, not CA. Hypothesis: async leaves cmd blocks unreaped; 48-entry/4 MiB cmdpool overflows with BM1 (128-draw, up to 2 MiB) batch blocks -> every overflow job allocs+maps+unmaps+releases its block. Host frame_bench (commit+wait per frame) shows 0 alloc/job, so I am adding the pipelined CA loop counters to reproduce.
